PLAN: CronSpec as DISTINCT type (ADR-0012) in toron-workflow.
1. schema.rs: CronSpec { name, schedule, owner, scope(host|project), mode(headless|pane), policy{on_failure,on_repeat_failure,repeat_threshold,on_success,max_retries,no_claim_timeout,catchup}, steps } + parse_cron(yaml) — same Step/Action DSL as Workflow.
2. lint.rs: cron_lint — cron-expr parse, policy fields, step/action resolution, graph acyclicity; DISTINCT from workflow lint (cron-YAML has schedule+owner; workflow-YAML rejects them).
3. Gate: parse_cron reads ADR-0012 weekly-upgrade YAML; cron lint validates; workflow lint REJECTS cron-YAML; unit tests.
TDD RED->GREEN. Reserved: crates/toron-workflow/src/{schema,lint}.rs. NOT touching cron.rs/cron_failure.rs/control_flow.rs (bd-m7ac in-flight).
